nodes.name: Operator (sudo)
nodes.summary: The Mac owner running CounterSpy under sudo to triage their machine and approve quarantine actions.
responsibilities: Maintain the user allowlist of vetted tools
security: Runs as root; sole approver of quarantine decisions

nodes.name: CounterSpy
nodes.summary: On-demand macOS spyware triage tool: collect four correlated signals, score, synthesize recommendations, reversibly quarantine on approval.
security: Runs under sudo
Never touches SIP/Apple-signed items
Reversible move-not-delete

nodes.name: macOS native tools
nodes.summary: The OS utilities CounterSpy shells out to at the collector exec edge.
responsibilities: Provide raw evidence: launchctl, plutil, codesign, spctl, ps, lsof, sqlite3 (TCC)
security: Gatekeeper verdict via spctl exit code is the trust anchor

nodes.name: counterspy binary
nodes.summary: The deployable unit: a single Go binary that orchestrates the three-phase pipeline.
security: Applies user allowlist
Only phase that reads stdin for consent

nodes.name: internal/model
nodes.summary: The shared vocabulary (Evidence, Subject, Finding, Assessment, Action, Manifest). No I/O; imports only fmt.
security: Namespaced Key() prevents subject-aliasing

nodes.name: internal/mark
nodes.summary: Pure symbology vocabulary: the concern/trust/liveness glyph marks, the uniform-cadence four-slot cluster, and the Legend that documents them. Shared by every render surface so the key can't drift.
security: Display-only — trust/liveness marks never change verdicts or scoring; Apple-authority check excludes the Developer-ID leaf so it can't be spoofed

nodes.name: internal/collect
nodes.summary: Four read-only collectors: persistence, tcc, proctree+network shell out to native tools (each split into a pure parser + an exec edge); codesign is IN-PROCESS via Security.framework (cgo), no codesign/spctl subprocess.
responsibilities: Gather evidence from native tools + Security.framework
Fail loud when a source is unreadable
security: argv[0] never used as identity
code signatures checked in-process (SecStaticCodeCheckValidity), no subprocess to spoof
authority = leaf-cert CN of a valid signature
observability: gap errors surfaced by the CLI

nodes.name: internal/score
nodes.summary: Pure scoring engine: group evidence by subject, sum weights, correlation multiplier, exact-match Apple allowlist suppression, hard tripwires.
security: Tripwire can never be suppressed by an allowlist hit

nodes.name: internal/interpret
nodes.summary: Pure, rule-based synthesizer: turns each Finding into a verdict, category, recommendation (Quarantine/Investigate/Monitor), a liveness run-state (active/armed/dormant), and a coarse concern band (trust×location×behavior) used for coloring/sorting the Findings view.
responsibilities: Recommend action (dormant remnants capped at Monitor)
security: Deterministic — no LLM in the decision path; verdicts are auditable

nodes.name: internal/report
nodes.summary: Presentation only: executive summary + ranked actionable findings (Monitor tier counted, not dumped) and a JSON form. RenderJSON emits a Snapshot {tool_version, gaps, assessments} so a --from load recovers collector gaps.
security: No analysis logic — cannot change verdicts

nodes.name: internal/act
nodes.summary: The only mutating phase: disable + MOVE artifacts (never delete) into a collision-proof quarantine mirror, with a self-written manifest; reversible restore.
responsibilities: Per-item undo (RestoreItem) — reverse one manifest item, trim it from the manifest
security: Never deletes
Refuses /System + Apple-signed
Path canonicalization
Restore refuses to overwrite

nodes.name: internal/tui
nodes.summary: Interactive tcell face over the two domains: Findings triage (master-detail over []Assessment) and the live Exfiltration monitor (per-app egress top, a btm-style per-app zoom dashboard, and on-demand flow inspection). Pure Model + update(key), tcell only at the view/Run edge, acting through locally-defined Actor/Sampler/Inspector seams. No analysis. Imports ONLY internal/model + internal/mark (enforced by TestDecouplingInvariant).
responsibilities: Render Findings triage (findings + evidence) and the Exfiltration monitor (tree, zoom, trend)
Navigate/filter/sort; quarantine with confirm; restore; inspect a flow (i); zoom an app (z)
Stay a thin face — imports only internal/model + internal/mark
security: Sanitizes attacker strings before drawing (via report.Clean at the CLI edge)
Acts only through the Actor interface (its guards apply)

nodes.name: internal/feedback
nodes.summary: Turns labeled findings into intrinsically-anonymous field reports and pushes them to a write-only sink. Egress-only: the Transmitter interface returns only error; the HTTP impl reads the status code and discards the body without decoding it; the tool never fetches from the network (enforced by TestEgressOnly). Off by default.
responsibilities: Minimize an Assessment to an anonymous fingerprint with public-identity gating
security: No raw path/username/hostname leaves the machine; paths become classes
Private identity dropped unless recognizably public or explicitly consented
Egress-only: no network reads, no remote config/allowlist/update

nodes.name: internal/ack
nodes.summary: Local, revisitable triage-decision store: records that the user reviewed a finding and chose to 'leave it'. Deliberately separate from internal/feedback — an ack is private and NEVER transmitted; it only affects how the Findings view flags a row. Fingerprints the finding's material state so a later change re-flags it 'reviewed · changed' rather than silently masking new signal.
responsibilities: Fingerprint(Assessment) — stable digest of score + evidence shape (Facts excluded)
Persist/clear local ack decisions keyed by Subject.Key()
Atomic write (temp+fsync+rename) under the invoking user's home
security: Local-only: acks are never transmitted (no network path in the package)
Stored under the invoking user's home, resolved even under sudo

nodes.name: internal/egress
nodes.summary: Sudo-CLI egress observation: polls nettop + lsof per tick, joins provenance/codesign-trust/TCC-capability from internal/collect, aggregates by application (collapsing pids/ports/protocols), and scores concern + exfiltration-risk (capability × egress). Pure given inputs; the exec edge + joins are injectable seams (mockable in CI). Observe-only at the tree level (reads no payloads); on demand, a selected flow can be handed to internal/inspect for a root /dev/bpf capture + honest coverage verdict.
responsibilities: Parse nettop/lsof; diff cumulative bytes to out-rates; classify cadence
Group by app; score concern; infer exfil risk + candidate categories
Feed the live TUI (via Sampler) and the non-TTY report
security: Observe-only; no blocking, no payload reading
Exfil is INFERRED from capability × egress, never confirmed content
Exec edge injectable so CI runs without sudo/tools

nodes.name: internal/inspect
nodes.summary: On-demand per-flow inspection engine. Opens a native /dev/bpf live capture scoped to one selected flow (BIOCSETIF/BIOCSETF filter, IPv4/IPv6 + TCP framing, link-layer strip), correlates both directions, and returns an HONEST coverage verdict: readable plaintext, TLS ciphertext (only with real evidence — SNI/handshake/TLS-port), or cleartext-binary. Reads the user’s OWN traffic locally; never decrypts; captured bytes are ephemeral and never leave the machine. Pure over an injectable PacketSource (CI-testable without root).
responsibilities: Capture one flow via native /dev/bpf (root), scoped by a cBPF host+TCP filter
Parse IPv4/IPv6 + TCP framing; correlate outbound/inbound
Classify coverage honestly (plaintext / TLS-ciphertext / cleartext-binary) + extract SNI
nodes.runtime: in-process (native /dev/bpf; requires root for live capture)
security: Root packet capture of the user’s OWN outbound traffic; least-privilege BPF filter scoped to the single flow
Never decrypts; TLS ciphertext is not surfaced; captured bytes are ephemeral (memory-only) and never leave the machine
Secrets in readable plaintext are masked until the user reveals (§6)
